lines.text: Unlocks: Clear event stage 102210111 · After Cats make the world go 'round. chat 3. Nero has invited Admi to join the group.

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: Ruru's become something of a sensation in the Ark.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: I can see why.

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: She is undeniably adorable.

lines.speaker: admi
lines.text: I don't think I've ever seen a cuter cat than her.

lines.speaker: admi
lines.text: Her eyes are so striking.

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: Meow

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: You're all preaching to the choir here.

lines.speaker: admi
lines.text: I wanna see her!

lines.speaker: admi
lines.text: Can I come over tomorrow?

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: How about we all pay her a visit tomorrow?

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: Sure.

lines.speaker: admi
lines.text: Ah.

lines.speaker: admi
lines.text: Um.

lines.speaker: admi
lines.text: Is it okay if I bring a toy?

lines.speaker: admi
lines.text: I was thinking about her a few days ago and bought one.

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: Of course you can.

lines.speaker: admi
lines.text: All right, sounds good!

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: You all should have seen Ruru today,

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: she was even cuter than usual.

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: She trundled over to me out of nowhere and started bumping her head up against me.

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: You should have heard her purring when I scratched under her chin.

lines.speaker: admi
lines.text: I'm jealous...

lines.speaker: admi
lines.text: If I scratch her tomorrow, do you think she'll purr for me as well?

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: I'd say it's a safe bet that she will, yes.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: I had a funny experience with Ruru today too.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: I was training with Timi,

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: and Ruru kept staring at us.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: When I asked if she needed something,

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: she plopped down onto the ground and rolled on her back, exposing her belly.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: It was a cuteness overload. I couldn't even.

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: She's so lovely!

lines.speaker: admi
lines.text: I can only imagine how adorable it was.
I got a flower from Ruru.

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: What?! Really?

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: Scoops got a flower from Ruru.

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: I'm so jealous!
We saw the night sky together too.

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: You're kidding!

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: Lol,

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: what a humblebrag, Zoo Keeper.
Hehe

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: Do you think Ruru is cute too, Trainer?
Yes I do.
No, I don't.
She's far more than cute. She's absolutely irresistible.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: Jeez, just listen to all of us gushing about her.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: We sound like a bunch of lovestruck admirers.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: We should change the name of the group chat to "Fallen for Ruru".

lines.speaker: admi
lines.text: Tomorrow couldn't come quickly enough.

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: I can't imagine my life without her.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: I feel the same.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: But parting with those we meet is an inevitable part of life.

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: Let's not dwell on such sad thoughts.

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: For the time being, Ruru is healthy enough.

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: Let's focus on enjoying the present.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: Nero is right.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: We need to shower her with all our love

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: and create as many memories as we can while we still have time.

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: Sounds like a plan!

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: I'm gonna kiss Ruru goodnight tonight.
I'm super jelly!

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: Hehe!
